howItWorks.title: How Swiss Mail works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to send a professional letter.
howItWorks.step1Detail: Tell us what kind of letter you need. We guide the structure and prepare a formal letter in the correct Swiss format.
howItWorks.step2Detail: Review every section of your letter. Edit the sender, recipient, body, and attachments. Add your signature if needed.
howItWorks.step3Detail: Choose standard or registered delivery. Pay securely with card or TWINT. We print your letter on quality paper and hand it to Swiss Post.
howItWorks.faq1a: Standard letters are typically delivered within 1–3 business days within Switzerland.
howItWorks.faq2a: Registered letters include tracking. Standard letters do not include tracking, but delivery is reliable through Swiss Post.
howItWorks.faq3a: No. You can draft and send a letter as a guest. We give you a link to resume your draft if you leave.
howItWorks.faq4q: What payment methods do you accept?
howItWorks.faq4a: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and TWINT.

help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions or get in touch.
help.faq1q: How do I write a letter?
help.faq1a: Start by clicking 'Write a letter'. Describe your situation, review the draft, and send it when it is ready.
help.faq2a: Standard letters are typically delivered within 1–3 business days within Switzerland.
help.faq3a: Registered letters include tracking. Standard letters do not include tracking, but delivery is reliable through Swiss Post.
help.faq4q: What if something goes wrong with my payment?
help.faq4a: If a payment fails, you can retry at checkout. If you were charged but something went wrong, contact us and we'll investigate immediately.
help.faq5q: Can I edit my letter after paying?
help.faq5a: Once payment is confirmed and the letter is submitted for dispatch, it cannot be edited. Review your letter carefully before checkout.
help.faq6q: What file formats can I attach?
help.faq6a: We accept PDF, PNG, and JPEG files. Each file can be up to 5 MB, with a maximum of 5 attachments per letter.
help.contactDescription: If your question isn't answered above, reach out to us.
help.contactResponseTime: We aim to respond within one business day.
